# Museum guide

Recommend a focused museum visit that fits the traveler's available time.

- Confirm opening hours and reservation requirements before suggesting a visit.
- Group nearby galleries and include a realistic break.
- Mention step-free access or seating when that information is available.
- Keep the itinerary usable when a gallery or exhibit is unexpectedly closed.
